name: Workday
tagline: Workday is a cloud-based human capital management and financial management platform used by over 10,000 organisations globally. Its AI features deliver workforce planning insights, predict employee attrition risk, and automate time-consuming HR and finance processes like headcount approvals and expense categorisation. Large enterprises in regulated industries choose Workday for its depth of HR and finance functionality in a single unified system.
